pathogen: HAV，引起甲型肝炎。
HAV causes hepatitis A.
structure: 二十面体蛋白衣壳；粪便排出的颗粒无包膜。
Icosahedral protein capsid; particles shed in stool are non-enveloped.
receptor: 本概览未核实具体受体；不能据此推断不存在受体。
Specific receptors were not verified for this overview; this does not imply their absence.
symptoms: 乏力、食欲减退、恶心、黄疸；儿童可无症状。
Fatigue, nausea, poor appetite and jaundice; children may be asymptomatic.
transmission: 粪口途径，包括污染食物、水和密切接触。
Faecal–oral spread through contaminated food, water and close contact.
risk: 少数出现急性肝衰竭；不形成慢性感染。
Rare acute liver failure; chronic infection does not occur.
prevention: 疫苗、安全饮水、食品卫生和洗手。
Vaccination, safe water, food hygiene and handwashing.
treatment: 支持治疗；重症需住院，无特异性抗病毒治疗。
Supportive care; severe illness needs hospital care. No specific antiviral treatment.
mechanism: 肝脏感染及免疫反应导致急性炎症。
Liver infection and immune responses cause acute inflammation.
progress: 疫苗已用于常规免疫和暴发控制。
Vaccines are established tools for routine immunization and outbreak control.
future: 研究重点建议（编辑综合）：改进成人易感人群识别与暴发应对。
Suggested priorities (editorial synthesis): Improve identification of susceptible adults and outbreak responses.

sources.title: ICTV · Picornaviridae
sources.scope: 病毒科、基因组与基本结构

pathogen: HBV，引起急性或慢性乙型肝炎。
HBV causes acute or chronic hepatitis B.
genome: 部分双链环状 DNA；复制涉及逆转录。
Partially double-stranded circular DNA; replication involves reverse transcription.
structure: 有包膜、二十面体核衣壳。
Enveloped virion with an icosahedral nucleocapsid.
receptor: NTCP 是已确认的肝细胞进入受体。
NTCP is an established hepatocyte entry receptor.
symptoms: 常无症状；可有乏力、恶心和黄疸。
Often silent; fatigue, nausea and jaundice may occur.
transmission: 血液、性接触及母婴传播。
Blood exposure, sexual contact and perinatal transmission.
risk: 肝硬化、肝癌及肝衰竭。
Cirrhosis, liver cancer and liver failure.
prevention: 疫苗、出生剂次、孕期筛查和安全注射。
Vaccination, birth dose, antenatal screening and safe injections.
treatment: 慢性患者可用核苷（酸）类似物抑制病毒；通常需长期管理。
Antivirals suppress chronic infection; long-term management is commonly needed.
mechanism: 肝细胞内持续性病毒储存与免疫损伤维持慢性病程。
Persistent viral templates and immune injury sustain chronic liver disease.
progress: WHO 已更新筛查和扩大治疗适用人群的指导。
WHO has updated guidance on testing and expanded treatment eligibility.
future: 研究重点建议（编辑综合）：持续缓解、肝癌预防及诊疗可及性。
Suggested priorities (editorial synthesis): Durable remission, cancer prevention and equitable access to care.

sources.title: ICTV · Hepadnaviridae
sources.scope: 病毒科、基因组、基本结构与受体

pathogen: HCV，引起急性或慢性丙型肝炎。
HCV causes acute or chronic hepatitis C.
receptor: 本概览未核实具体受体；不能据此推断不存在受体。
Specific receptors were not verified for this overview; this does not imply their absence.
symptoms: 常长期无症状；可有乏力、恶心、黄疸。
Often silent for years; fatigue, nausea and jaundice can occur.
transmission: 主要经血液；也可围产期或经有血液暴露的性接触传播。
Mainly bloodborne; perinatal and blood-associated sexual transmission can occur.
risk: 肝硬化和肝细胞癌。
Cirrhosis and hepatocellular carcinoma.
prevention: 血液筛查、安全注射和减害服务；尚无有效疫苗。
Blood screening, safe injections and harm reduction; no effective vaccine.
treatment: 直接作用抗病毒药可治愈绝大多数感染者。
Direct-acting antivirals cure most infections.
mechanism: 持续肝脏感染引发慢性炎症与纤维化。
Persistent liver infection causes inflammation and fibrosis.
progress: 可治愈治疗已建立，但诊断与治疗覆盖仍不足。
Curative therapy is established, but testing and treatment gaps persist.
future: 研究重点建议（编辑综合）：扩大检测、预防再感染及建立有效疫苗。
Suggested priorities (editorial synthesis): Expand diagnosis, prevent reinfection and develop effective vaccines.

sources.title: ICTV · Flaviviridae
sources.scope: 病毒科、基因组与基本结构

pathogen: HDV；人体感染依赖伴随 HBV 感染。
HDV; human infection depends on accompanying HBV infection.
structure: 核糖核蛋白外包裹 HBV 来源的包膜。
Ribonucleoprotein enclosed in an HBV-derived envelope.
receptor: 本概览未核实具体受体；不能据此推断不存在受体。
Specific receptors were not verified for this overview; this does not imply their absence.
symptoms: 乏力、恶心、黄疸，可有严重肝炎。
Fatigue, nausea and jaundice; severe hepatitis is possible.
transmission: 血液和体液；性传播，母婴传播较少。
Blood and body fluids, sexual contact; perinatal transmission is less common.
risk: 重症肝炎、快速进展的肝硬化及肝癌。
Severe hepatitis, rapidly progressive cirrhosis and liver cancer.
prevention: 乙肝疫苗可预防未感染 HBV 者的丁肝；已感染 HBV 者不因此获保护。
HBV vaccination prevents HDV in HBV-uninfected people, not existing HBV carriers.
treatment: 专科治疗；干扰素及部分地区获批的布来维肽。
Specialist care: interferon and bulevirtide where approved.
mechanism: 在 HBV 背景下加重肝脏炎症；严重化机制仍不完全清楚。
HDV aggravates HBV-associated liver injury; severity mechanisms remain incompletely understood.
progress: 欧洲已有新疗法获批；疗程及联合方案仍在评估。
New therapy is approved in Europe; duration and combinations remain under evaluation.
future: 研究重点建议（编辑综合）：改善诊断可及性和长期治疗结局。
Suggested priorities (editorial synthesis): Improve diagnosis and long-term treatment outcomes.

sources.title: WHO · Hepatitis D virus

sources.title: ICTV · Kolmioviridae
sources.scope: 病毒科、基因组与基本结构

pathogen: HEV，引起戊型肝炎。
HEV causes hepatitis E.
structure: 无包膜及准包膜形式，取决于体内位置。
Non-enveloped and quasi-enveloped forms occur in different compartments.
receptor: 本概览未核实具体受体；不能据此推断不存在受体。
Specific receptors were not verified for this overview; this does not imply their absence.
symptoms: 发热、食欲下降、恶心和黄疸。
Fever, appetite loss, nausea and jaundice.
transmission: 污染饮水；部分感染与未熟动物食品有关。
Contaminated water; some infections follow undercooked animal products.
risk: 孕妇可发生重症；免疫抑制者可慢性化。
Severe disease in pregnancy; chronic infection in immunosuppressed people.
prevention: 安全饮水、食品充分煮熟；疫苗可及性因地区而异。
Safe water and thoroughly cooked food; vaccine access varies geographically.
treatment: 通常支持治疗；重症、妊娠及慢性感染需专科评估。
Usually supportive care; severe, pregnancy-associated or chronic infection needs specialist assessment.
mechanism: 肝脏感染导致炎症；宿主状态影响清除和严重程度。
Liver infection causes inflammation; host status affects clearance and severity.
progress: 已有疫苗用于部分地区及暴发应对。
A vaccine is used in some settings and outbreak responses.
future: 研究重点建议（编辑综合）：妊娠保护、慢性病例管理及扩大疫苗证据。
Suggested priorities (editorial synthesis): Protection in pregnancy, chronic-disease care and broader vaccine evidence.

sources.title: ICTV · Hepeviridae
sources.scope: 病毒科、基因组与基本结构

zh: 人类免疫缺陷病毒（1/2 型）

pathogen: HIV-1 与 HIV-2；未经治疗可导致艾滋病。
HIV-1 and HIV-2; untreated infection can lead to AIDS.
genome: 两份正链 RNA，经过 DNA 中间体复制。
Two positive-sense RNA copies; replication uses a DNA intermediate.
receptor: CD4 与共受体 CCR5 或 CXCR4 参与进入。
CD4 and the coreceptors CCR5 or CXCR4 support entry.
symptoms: 急性期类似流感，随后可长期无症状。
Acute flu-like illness, followed by a potentially long silent period.
transmission: 性接触、血液、妊娠、分娩和哺乳；不经普通接触传播。
Sex, blood, pregnancy, childbirth and breastfeeding; not casual contact.
risk: 免疫缺陷、机会性感染及相关肿瘤。
Immunodeficiency, opportunistic infections and associated cancers.
prevention: 安全性行为、PrEP/PEP、无菌针具及有效治疗。
Safer sex, PrEP/PEP, sterile needles and effective treatment.
treatment: 联合抗逆转录病毒治疗；持续病毒抑制可防止性传播。
Combination ART; sustained viral suppression prevents sexual transmission.
mechanism: 感染免疫细胞并形成持续感染，逐渐损害免疫防御。
Persistent infection of immune cells progressively weakens immune defence.
progress: 治疗已使 HIV 成为可管理的慢性疾病。
Treatment has made HIV a manageable chronic condition.
future: 研究重点建议（编辑综合）：持久缓解、预防工具可及性及减少污名。
Suggested priorities (editorial synthesis): Durable remission, prevention access and reduction of stigma.

sources.title: ICTV · Retroviridae
sources.scope: 病毒科、基因组、基本结构与受体

zh: 人类嗜 T 淋巴细胞病毒 1 型

pathogen: HTLV-1，造成终身感染的逆转录病毒。
HTLV-1 is a retrovirus causing lifelong infection.
genome: RNA 逆转录为整合的 DNA。
RNA is reverse-transcribed into integrated DNA.
receptor: 本概览未核实具体受体；不能据此推断不存在受体。
Specific receptors were not verified for this overview; this does not imply their absence.
symptoms: 多数无症状；可出现皮肤、眼及神经系统疾病。
Usually asymptomatic; skin, eye and neurological disease can occur.
transmission: 性接触、哺乳、共用针具和不安全输血。
Sex, breastfeeding, shared needles and unsafe transfusion.
risk: 成人 T 细胞白血病/淋巴瘤及进行性脊髓病。
Adult T-cell leukaemia/lymphoma and progressive myelopathy.
prevention: 血液筛查、安全性行为、无菌针具及个体化喂养咨询。
Blood screening, safer sex, sterile needles and individualized feeding counselling.
treatment: 没有清除感染的常规治疗；按相关疾病进行专科治疗。
No routine eradication treatment; specialists treat associated diseases.
mechanism: 持续感染与免疫失调可造成炎症和异常细胞增生。
Persistent infection and immune dysregulation can cause inflammation and abnormal cell growth.
progress: WHO 正推进检测与预防指导；尚无疫苗。
WHO is developing testing and prevention guidance; no vaccine is available.
future: 研究重点建议（编辑综合）：疾病负担估计、早期风险识别及预防措施评估。
Suggested priorities (editorial synthesis): Burden estimates, early risk detection and evaluation of prevention strategies.

sources.scope: 病毒科、基因组与基本结构

pathogen: 人类诺如病毒群，引起急性胃肠炎。
Human noroviruses cause acute gastroenteritis.
receptor: 本概览未核实具体受体；不能据此推断不存在受体。
Specific receptors were not verified for this overview; this does not imply their absence.
symptoms: 呕吐、腹泻、恶心和腹痛。
Vomiting, diarrhoea, nausea and abdominal pain.
transmission: 粪口传播、污染食品或表面，以及呕吐物污染。
Faecal–oral transmission, contaminated food or surfaces and contamination from vomit.
risk: 脱水；幼儿、老人和免疫低下者尤需关注。
Dehydration, especially in young children, older adults and immunocompromised people.
prevention: 肥皂洗手、食品卫生及规范清洁污染环境。
Soap-and-water handwashing, food hygiene and appropriate cleaning.
treatment: 补液与支持治疗；严重脱水需医疗处理。
Rehydration and supportive care; severe dehydration needs medical attention.
mechanism: 肠道感染扰乱消化吸收和液体平衡。
Intestinal infection disrupts digestive function and fluid balance.
progress: 不同型别可重复感染；免疫保护持续时间仍不清楚。
Repeated infections occur across types; duration of protective immunity remains uncertain.
future: 研究重点建议（编辑综合）：更持久广谱的预防和高风险机构暴发控制。
Suggested priorities (editorial synthesis): Durable broad protection and outbreak control in vulnerable institutions.

sources.title: ICTV · Caliciviridae
sources.scope: 病毒科、基因组与基本结构

pathogen: 人类疾病以 A 组轮状病毒为主。
Group A rotaviruses cause most human rotavirus disease.
structure: 无包膜、多层二十面体衣壳。
Non-enveloped virions with multilayered icosahedral capsids.
receptor: 本概览未核实具体受体；不能据此推断不存在受体。
Specific receptors were not verified for this overview; this does not imply their absence.
symptoms: 水样腹泻、呕吐、发热和腹痛。
Watery diarrhoea, vomiting, fever and abdominal pain.
transmission: 粪口途径，常见于家庭和托幼场所。
Faecal–oral transmission, often in households and childcare settings.
risk: 婴幼儿严重脱水，可能危及生命。
Severe, potentially fatal dehydration in infants and young children.
prevention: 按当地程序接种疫苗，保持手和环境卫生。
Routine vaccination according to local schedules, hand and environmental hygiene.
treatment: 补液为核心；无常规特异性抗病毒药。
Rehydration is central; no routine specific antiviral treatment.
mechanism: 肠道感染破坏液体平衡，引起分泌和吸收异常。
Intestinal infection disrupts fluid balance and absorption.
progress: 疫苗已成为预防儿童重症的成熟工具。
Vaccination is an established tool against severe childhood disease.
future: 研究重点建议（编辑综合）：提高覆盖率并改善低资源地区的保护效果。
Suggested priorities (editorial synthesis): Increase coverage and improve protection in resource-limited settings.

sources.title: ICTV · Sedoreoviridae
sources.scope: 病毒科、基因组与基本结构

pathogen: 脊髓灰质炎的病原；属于肠道病毒。
Enteroviruses responsible for poliomyelitis.
receptor: 本概览未核实具体受体；不能据此推断不存在受体。
Specific receptors were not verified for this overview; this does not imply their absence.
symptoms: 可无症状；发热、乏力，少数出现瘫痪。
May be silent; fever and fatigue, with paralysis in a minority.
transmission: 主要粪口传播，包括污染水或食物。
Predominantly faecal–oral, including contaminated water or food.
risk: 不可逆瘫痪和呼吸肌麻痹。
Irreversible paralysis and respiratory muscle failure.
prevention: 按当地程序接种脊灰疫苗及改善卫生。
Polio vaccination according to local schedules and improved sanitation.
treatment: 没有治愈方法；支持治疗、呼吸支持与康复。
No cure; supportive care, respiratory support and rehabilitation.
mechanism: 肠道感染后，少数病例发生神经系统损伤。
Intestinal infection can occasionally lead to nervous-system injury.
progress: 全球根除行动已大幅减少病例，但传播尚未完全消除。
Eradication efforts have greatly reduced cases, but transmission has not ended.
future: 研究重点建议（编辑综合）：弥补免疫缺口，持续监测并保障根除后的防护。
Suggested priorities (editorial synthesis): Close immunity gaps, sustain surveillance and maintain post-eradication protection.

sources.title: ICTV · Picornaviridae
sources.scope: 病毒科、基因组与基本结构

pathogen: EV-A71，是手足口病的重要病原之一。
EV-A71 is an important cause of hand, foot and mouth disease.
receptor: 本概览未核实具体受体；不能据此推断不存在受体。
Specific receptors were not verified for this overview; this does not imply their absence.
symptoms: 发热、口腔疱疹及手足皮疹，也可无症状。
Fever, mouth sores and hand/foot rash; some infections are silent.
transmission: 粪便、呼吸道分泌物、疱液和污染物接触。
Contact with stool, respiratory secretions, blister fluid and contaminated objects.
risk: 少数出现脑炎、脑膜炎或急性弛缓性脊髓炎。
Rare encephalitis, meningitis or acute flaccid myelitis.
prevention: 洗手、清洁和减少密切接触；疫苗供应因国家而异。
Handwashing, cleaning and reduced close contact; vaccine availability varies by country.
treatment: 无特异性治疗；神经系统重症需住院支持治疗。
No specific treatment; severe neurological illness needs hospital supportive care.
mechanism: 常见黏膜感染，少数可累及中枢神经系统。
Usually mucosal infection; the central nervous system is occasionally affected.
progress: 已制定疫苗国际标准；并非所有国家均提供疫苗。
International vaccine standards exist; vaccines are not available in every country.
future: 研究重点建议（编辑综合）：提升重症预警和对多病原手足口病的防护。
Suggested priorities (editorial synthesis): Improve warning signs and protection against multiple HFMD pathogens.

sources.title: WHO · Enterovirus 71 vaccine standards
sources.scope: 疫苗标准与研究进展

pathogen: DENV，有四种主要血清型。
DENV comprises four major serotypes.
receptor: 本概览未核实具体受体；不能据此推断不存在受体。
Specific receptors were not verified for this overview; this does not imply their absence.
symptoms: 发热、头痛、肌肉关节痛、恶心和皮疹。
Fever, headache, muscle/joint pain, nausea and rash.
transmission: 主要通过感染的伊蚊叮咬。
Primarily bites from infected Aedes mosquitoes.
risk: 重症血浆渗漏、休克、出血和器官损伤。
Severe plasma leakage, shock, bleeding and organ injury.
prevention: 防蚊和蚊媒控制；疫苗按当地适应证使用。
Bite prevention, vector control and vaccination under local indications.
treatment: 监测和补液；无特异性药物，避免阿司匹林及布洛芬。
Monitoring and fluids; no specific medicine. Avoid aspirin and ibuprofen.
mechanism: 病毒感染及宿主免疫反应可引起血管通透性异常。
Infection and host immune responses can disrupt vascular permeability.
progress: 已有疫苗，但适用人群、年龄及既往感染要求依产品而异。
Vaccines exist; eligibility and previous-infection requirements vary by product.
future: 研究重点建议（编辑综合）：改进重症预测、疫苗公平性及可持续蚊媒控制。
Suggested priorities (editorial synthesis): Improve severity prediction, vaccine equity and sustainable vector control.

pathogen: ZIKV，引起寨卡病毒病。
ZIKV causes Zika virus disease.
receptor: 本概览未核实具体受体；不能据此推断不存在受体。
Specific receptors were not verified for this overview; this does not imply their absence.
symptoms: 多无症状；可有低热、皮疹、结膜炎及关节痛。
Often silent; fever, rash, conjunctivitis and joint pain may occur.
transmission: 伊蚊叮咬，也可性传播和母胎传播。
Aedes mosquito bites, sexual and maternal–fetal transmission.
risk: 先天性畸形、妊娠丢失及吉兰–巴雷综合征。
Congenital abnormalities, pregnancy loss and Guillain–Barré syndrome.
prevention: 防蚊、安全性行为及孕期旅行风险咨询。
Bite prevention, safer sex and pregnancy travel-risk counselling.
treatment: 支持治疗；妊娠暴露和神经症状需专科评估。
Supportive care; pregnancy exposure and neurological symptoms need specialist assessment.
mechanism: 感染可损害发育中胎儿组织；少数发生免疫相关神经损伤。
Infection can harm developing fetal tissues; immune-associated neurological injury occasionally occurs.
progress: WHO 概览尚未报告可用的预防疫苗。
The WHO overview reports no available preventive vaccine.
future: 研究重点建议（编辑综合）：母婴长期随访、可靠诊断及安全有效的预防工具。
Suggested priorities (editorial synthesis): Long-term mother–child follow-up, reliable diagnosis and safe prevention tools.

pathogen: CHIKV，引起基孔肯雅热。
CHIKV causes chikungunya disease.
structure: 有包膜，二十面体核衣壳。
Enveloped virions with an icosahedral nucleocapsid.
receptor: 本概览未核实具体受体；不能据此推断不存在受体。
Specific receptors were not verified for this overview; this does not imply their absence.
symptoms: 发热、明显关节痛、皮疹及乏力。
Fever, prominent joint pain, rash and fatigue.
transmission: 主要经伊蚊传播。
Primarily transmitted by Aedes mosquitoes.
risk: 持续性关节疼痛；婴儿和老年人偶有严重器官并发症。
Persistent joint pain; occasional severe organ complications in infants and older adults.
prevention: 防蚊；疫苗接种须结合当地最新产品与适应证。
Prevent mosquito bites; vaccination depends on current local products and eligibility.
treatment: 支持与镇痛治疗；排除登革热前避免非甾体抗炎药。
Supportive care and pain relief; avoid NSAIDs until dengue is excluded.
mechanism: 感染与炎症反应可导致急性及持续关节症状。
Infection and inflammatory responses cause acute and persistent joint symptoms.
progress: VIMKUNYA 已在美国可用；疫苗安全性与适应证持续更新。
VIMKUNYA is available in the US; safety guidance and indications continue to evolve.
future: 研究重点建议（编辑综合）：评估长期保护、安全性及慢性关节病管理。
Suggested priorities (editorial synthesis): Assess lasting protection, safety and management of chronic joint disease.

zh: 日本脑炎病毒（乙脑病毒）

pathogen: JEV，引起流行性乙型脑炎。
JEV causes Japanese encephalitis.
receptor: 本概览未核实具体受体；不能据此推断不存在受体。
Specific receptors were not verified for this overview; this does not imply their absence.
symptoms: 多数无症状；重症高热、意识障碍和抽搐。
Usually silent; severe illness causes fever, confusion and seizures.
transmission: 库蚊传播；动物–蚊循环，人一般为终末宿主。
Culex mosquitoes; animal–mosquito cycles, with humans usually dead-end hosts.
risk: 脑炎死亡及持久认知、运动或行为障碍。
Fatal encephalitis and lasting cognitive, motor or behavioural disability.
prevention: 风险地区接种疫苗，采取防蚊措施。
Vaccination in risk settings and mosquito-bite prevention.
treatment: 无特异性抗病毒治疗；紧急支持治疗与康复。
No specific antiviral; urgent supportive care and rehabilitation.
mechanism: 少数感染累及中枢神经系统并引起炎症损伤。
A minority of infections reach the central nervous system and cause inflammatory injury.
progress: 安全有效疫苗及免疫项目已减少部分地区疾病负担。
Effective vaccines and immunization programmes have reduced disease burden in some settings.
future: 研究重点建议（编辑综合）：补足免疫覆盖、改善脑炎诊断和长期康复。
Suggested priorities (editorial synthesis): Close vaccine gaps, improve encephalitis diagnosis and long-term rehabilitation.
